title: Planet
description: Planet record (public/data/planets/*.json) — APP-OWNED World Model Schema v2.0 content (hand-authored GM toolkit + Planet Compendium extractions). This schema is a CAPTURE of the existing contract (world-links D-WL1: schema + integrity only, no ingest, no shape change). Corrected census (world-links-recon ruling): 80 records — 27 record_depth 'full' + 53 'identity'; NO 'nav' depth exists (lightweight nav entries live in planets_nav.json, which is NOT a planet record and is out of this schema). Both depth tiers carry the SAME 15 top-level sections (verified on all 80) — depth describes CONTENT richness, not structure.
$comment: Companion files disposition (D-WL1 condition 3, stated): *_gaps.json + gap_report.json are AUDIT ARTIFACTS, not planet records — scoped OUT of this schema; the validate_registries world-links layer checks only that every *_gaps.json id resolves to a planet record. planets_nav.json is a separate nav index, also out. Value-level constraints minimal by design (capture, not authoring standards). ARCHITECTURAL RULE preserved (DATA_INVENTORY §5): the Rebel Alliance does NOT appear in planet factions[] — rebel presence is campaign_state presets + the galaxy faction file.

record_depth.description: full = all GM-toolkit sections populated (27 records); identity = compendium-extracted lookup depth (53 records). Same section list either way.

factions.description: Planet-LOCAL faction instances (e.g. imperial_garrison_jedha) — ids are local by design and deliberately do NOT need to match the galaxy faction registry. The registry link is galaxy_faction_ref.

id.description: Planet-local instance id (NOT a registry id).

galaxy_faction_ref.$comment: THE planet->galaxy-faction link (world-links R-WL2): when non-null, MUST resolve to a faction registry id — enforced by validate_registries with adjudicated exceptions ledgered in scripts/canonical/planet_faction_gaps.json (never waived silently). null = explicitly link-unknown (24 entries today); absent = local-only faction (60 entries today); non-null = 17 entries, of which 2 are pending adjudication (D-WL5: mining_guild, church_of_the_force).
